title: Enterprise data governance request triage framework and scoring rubric
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Summary: Create a repeatable intake and prioritization process for enterprise requests related to data governance controls (logging redaction, retention windows, PII handling, audit exports). Goal is to reduce ad-hoc engineering effort, surface security/compliance risk early, and enable predictable delivery for Dedicated/Private customers.

Scope: Non-bug feature requests from customers and Sales/Support that touch data capture, storage, or export. Includes: 1) structured logging redaction rules and redaction pipeline, 2) configurable retention windows per tenant and global defaults, 3) automated PII detection + masking hooks, 4) audit export formats and bulk export APIs, 5) admin UX for policy configuration.

Problem statement: Over the last 6 months we had five enterprise requests (FinanceA, HealthCo, RetailX, GovPilot, EduCorp) with divergent asks. Engineering has implemented point solutions for two customers which created maintenance overhead and inconsistent guarantees. Sales needs a clear playbook for scoping and communicating timelines to prospects. Security needs consistent review gates.

Proposed deliverables: 1) Triage rubric & scoring model (security risk, regulatory urgency, customer ARR, engineering effort, cross-customer applicability). 2) Intake form template (Sales/Support + self-serve), mapped to labels and metadata. 3) PM-led weekly triage meeting with ENG/SEC reps. 4) Canonical PRD for prioritized initiatives and an advisory list of acceptable interim mitigations. 5) Example policy UI wireframes and API contract sketch for retention & export.

Success metrics: time-to-first-response <= 3 business days for enterprise asks; triage-to-commit decision within 2 cycles for P0/P1; reduced custom one-off implementations by 80% in 6 months; SLAed delivery for at-risk customers where required.

Scoring rubric documented in Confluence with worked examples and threshold mapping to priority buckets (P0/P1/P2).

Communications: sales playbook excerpt and canned responses for Support explaining timelines and interim mitigations.
No open enterprise requests for ad-hoc one-offs older than 90 days without a mitigation plan.
